snippet.description:
Does writing more in UPSC Mains mean scoring more marks? Not necessarily.

Nishat Sir, Sociology Faculty at LevelUp IAS, explains why to-the-point and impactful answers can help you maximise your UPSC Mains score. The goal is not to fill pages, but to write what is relevant, precise and capable of making an impact on the examiner.

Writing concisely is a skill that develops through practice. With consistent answer writing and the right guidance, you can gradually learn to communicate more in fewer words.

Write less. Make more impact. Score better.
